page.title: 差の大きさを前に置く

analysis.summaryJa: 比較級の前にa little・much・far・even・具体的な数値や倍率を置き、差の大きさを測る仕組みを扱う。many more＋可算複数とmuch more＋不可算の区別、than後に名詞・場所・行動・節を置ける柔軟性も検証する。
grammarPoints: a little＋比較級で小さな差を示す
much・far・even＋比較級で大きな差や強調を示す
数値・単位＋比較級で正確な差を示す
倍率＋as ... asやtimes＋比較級で倍率を示す
many more＋可算複数とmuch more＋不可算を使い分ける
than後には名詞・場所・行動・節を置ける
visualEvidence: 小さいから大きいへ動く差のスケールとa little・much・far・even・数値・倍率のつまみ
many more＋可算の椅子とmuch more＋不可算の雲を分けた右側の表示
数値で身長差、倍率で速度差を示すカード
than後は名詞・場所・行動もよいと示す標的の注記
commonTraps: 可算複数にmuch more、不可算にmany moreを使う
数値差をthanの後ろへ誤配置する
倍率表現でtimesとthanの構造を混同する
than後の比較対象の形を不釣り合いにする

questions.prompt: The updated map is ------- clearer than the photocopy, so visitors can read it easily.

choices.B: most

questions.translationJa: 更新版の地図はコピーよりはるかに鮮明なので、来訪者が簡単に読めます。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級clearerの大きな差はmuchで修飾します。very clearerとはしません。

questions.prompt: The new chair is ------- more comfortable than the old one, but the difference is small.

choices.B: very

questions.translationJa: 新しい椅子は古いものより少し快適ですが、差は小さいです。
questions.explanationJa: 小さな差という文脈なのでa little more comfortableが適切です。

questions.prompt: The renovated hall can accommodate 120 ------- guests than before.

choices.B: most

questions.translationJa: 改装されたホールは以前より120人多くの客を収容できます。
questions.explanationJa: 具体的な差は数値＋more＋複数名詞の順に置きます。

questions.prompt: The express train reaches the airport forty minutes ------- than the local train.

choices.B: earlier

questions.translationJa: 急行列車は普通列車より40分早く空港に着きます。
questions.explanationJa: 正確な時間差はforty minutes earlier thanで表します。

questions.prompt: The warehouse needs ------- more shelves, but only a little more floor space.

choices.B: much

questions.translationJa: 倉庫には棚がはるかに多く必要ですが、床面積は少し増えれば十分です。
questions.explanationJa: 数えられる複数名詞shelvesの大幅な追加にはmany moreを使います。

questions.prompt: The digital archive provides ------- more information than the printed index.

choices.B: very

questions.translationJa: デジタル資料庫は印刷版索引よりはるかに多くの情報を提供します。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算名詞informationの大きな量の差はmuch moreで表します。

questions.prompt: This year’s application process is even ------- than last year’s.

choices.B: simpler

questions.translationJa: 今年の応募手続きは昨年よりさらに簡単です。
questions.explanationJa: evenは比較級simplerを強めます。

questions.prompt: The new battery lasts three times ------- than the previous model.

choices.B: as long

questions.translationJa: 新しい電池は旧型より3倍長く持続します。
questions.explanationJa: three times longer thanで比較上の倍率を表します。

questions.prompt: Working from the branch office is far more convenient ------- commuting downtown.

choices.B: as

questions.translationJa: 支店で働く方が都心へ通勤するよりはるかに便利です。
questions.explanationJa: 行動句同士を比べ、far more ... thanで大差を示します。

questions.prompt: The replacement motor consumes 15 percent ------- electricity than the old motor.

choices.B: few

questions.translationJa: 交換後のモーターは旧型より電力消費が15パーセント少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算名詞electricityの正確な減少は15 percent lessで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a small price difference.

choices.A: The blue folder is very cheaper than the red one.
choices.B: The blue folder is a little cheaper than the red one.
choices.C: The blue folder is a little cheapest than the red one.
choices.D: The blue folder is little more cheap than the red one.

questions.translationJa: 青いフォルダーは赤いものより少し安いです。
questions.explanationJa: a littleは比較級cheaperの小さな差を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a large improvement.

choices.A: The revised manual is very easier to follow.
choices.B: The revised manual is far easiest to follow.
choices.C: The revised manual is more far easy to follow.
choices.D: The revised manual is far easier to follow.

questions.translationJa: 改訂版マニュアルは以前よりはるかに分かりやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: farは比較級easierを強め、基準は文脈から省けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving an exact height difference.

choices.A: The new counter is ten centimeters lower than the old one.
choices.B: The new counter is lower ten centimeters than the old one.
choices.C: The new counter is ten centimeters lowest than the old one.
choices.D: The new counter is very ten centimeters lower than the old one.

questions.translationJa: 新しいカウンターは古いものより10センチ低いです。
questions.explanationJa: 差の数値は比較級lowerの直前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence requesting additional countable items.

choices.A: We need much more name tags for the afternoon session.
choices.B: We need very more name tags for the afternoon session.
choices.C: We need many more name tags for the afternoon session.
choices.D: We need many much name tags for the afternoon session.

questions.translationJa: 午後の部には名札がはるかに多く必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数name tagsの大幅な追加はmany moreです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about additional uncountable work.

choices.A: The audit required many more time than we had planned.
choices.B: The audit required very more time than we had planned.
choices.C: The audit required much many time than we had planned.
choices.D: The audit required much more time than we had planned.

questions.translationJa: 監査には予定よりはるかに多くの時間が必要でした。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算名詞timeの大きな量の差にはmuch moreを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence emphasizing a surprising difference.

choices.A: The weekday fare is even lowest than the weekend fare.
choices.B: The weekday fare is even lower than the weekend fare.
choices.C: The weekday fare is very lower than the weekend fare.
choices.D: The weekday fare is even low than the weekend fare.

questions.translationJa: 平日の運賃は週末運賃よりさらに安いです。
questions.explanationJa: evenは比較級lowerを強め、意外な差を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing two activities.

choices.A: Taking the shuttle is more economical than to drive.
choices.B: Taking the shuttle is economicaler than driving.
choices.C: Taking the shuttle is more economical than driving.
choices.D: Taking the shuttle is most economical than driving.

questions.translationJa: シャトルに乗る方が運転するより経済的です。
questions.explanationJa: Takingとdrivingという動名詞句をthanで釣り合いよく比較します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing a multiple.

choices.A: The new line prints twice as many labels as the old line.
choices.B: The new line prints twice more labels than the old line.
choices.C: The new line prints twice as much labels as the old line.
choices.D: The new line prints two times labels as many as the old line.

questions.translationJa: 新しい生産ラインは旧ラインの2倍の数のラベルを印刷します。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数labelsの倍率はtwice as many ... asで明確に表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a percentage difference.

choices.A: Online registration takes less 30 percent time than registration by mail.
choices.B: Online registration takes 30 percent fewer time than registration by mail.
choices.C: Online registration takes 30 percent least time than registration by mail.
choices.D: Online registration takes 30 percent less time than registration by mail.

questions.translationJa: オンライン登録は郵送登録より30パーセント短い時間で済みます。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算timeの減少は数値＋less time thanの順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing a place and a prior experience.

choices.A: The lobby was very busier than I had seen it before.
choices.B: The lobby was much busiest than I had seen it before.
choices.C: The lobby was much busier than I had seen it before.
choices.D: The lobby was more busy much than before I had seen it.

questions.translationJa: ロビーは私が以前見たときよりはるかに混雑していました。
questions.explanationJa: much busierが大差を、than節が過去の経験を基準として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The second estimate is a little lower."

choices.A: The estimates are exactly the same.
choices.B: The second estimate is far below the first.
choices.C: Only the second estimate has been approved.
choices.D: The second estimate is slightly below the first.

questions.translationJa: 2番目の見積額は最初のものをわずかに下回ります。
questions.explanationJa: a little lowerはslightly belowと同じ小さな差です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The new process is much faster."

choices.B: The new process saves a substantial amount of time.
choices.C: The old process required no time.

questions.translationJa: 新しい工程は大幅に時間を節約します。
questions.explanationJa: much fasterは速度差が大きく、所要時間を相当に短縮することを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The parcel is two kilograms lighter than the limit."

choices.A: The parcel exceeds the limit by two kilograms.
choices.B: The limit was reduced to two kilograms.
choices.C: The parcel weighs two kilograms less than the maximum allowed.
choices.D: The parcel and the limit have equal weight.

questions.translationJa: 小包は許容上限より2キロ軽いです。
questions.explanationJa: 数値＋lighter thanは上限との差を正確に示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We need many more volunteers."

choices.A: The current number of volunteers is far from sufficient.
choices.B: We need a large amount of volunteer work.
choices.C: Only one more volunteer is required.
choices.D: We have more volunteers than we can use.

questions.translationJa: 現在のボランティア数では大幅に足りません。
questions.explanationJa: many more volunteersは、数えられる人員が多数追加で必要という意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The project requires much more patience."

choices.A: The project needs many patient employees only.
choices.B: The present amount of patience will not be nearly enough.
choices.C: The project can be finished immediately.
choices.D: Patience is less useful for this project.

questions.translationJa: 今の忍耐力ではこの計画には到底足りません。
questions.explanationJa: much more patienceは不可算の性質・量が大幅に必要だということです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The revised offer is even more attractive."

choices.A: The offer is now less attractive.
choices.B: The offer is the only one available.
choices.C: No comparison can be made with the earlier offer.
choices.D: The offer has improved beyond an already favorable level.

questions.translationJa: 改訂案は、すでに好ましかった水準をさらに上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: even moreは既存の比較差をさらに強調します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The new room is three times as large as the old one."

choices.A: The new room has triple the area of the old room.
choices.B: The old room is three square meters smaller.
choices.D: The new room is one third as large.

questions.translationJa: 新しい部屋の面積は古い部屋の3倍です。
questions.explanationJa: three times as large asは面積が3倍という倍率です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The visit took an hour longer than expected."

choices.A: The visit ended one hour before schedule.
choices.B: The expected visit was one hour long.
choices.C: The visit exceeded the planned duration by one hour.
choices.D: No duration was planned for the visit.

questions.translationJa: 訪問は予定時間を1時間超えました。
questions.explanationJa: an hour longer thanは予定との差が1時間だと限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Remote support is far more convenient than an on-site visit."

choices.A: An on-site visit is considerably less convenient than remote support.
choices.B: Both support methods are equally convenient.
choices.C: Remote support is slightly less convenient.

questions.translationJa: 現地訪問は遠隔サポートよりかなり不便です。
questions.explanationJa: 比較対象を逆にし、far more convenientをconsiderably less convenientとすれば関係が保たれます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The shop sold 200 fewer units this month."

choices.A: Exactly 200 units were sold this month.
choices.B: This month’s unit sales were lower by exactly 200.
choices.C: Sales were 200 times lower this month.

questions.translationJa: 今月の販売個数は正確に200個減りました。
questions.explanationJa: 数値＋fewer unitsは可算個数の正確な減少を表します。

questions.prompt: The old reception desk was 95 centimeters high. The new accessible desk is five centimeters -------.

choices.B: very low

questions.translationJa: 旧受付台は高さ95センチでした。新しいバリアフリー受付台は5センチ低いです。
questions.explanationJa: 正確な差はfive centimeters lowerとします。

questions.prompt: The first draft needed only minor changes. The final draft is ------- more concise.

choices.B: very

questions.translationJa: 初稿には小さな変更だけが必要でした。最終稿は少し簡潔になっています。
questions.explanationJa: minor changesという手掛かりから、小差を表すa littleが適切です。

questions.prompt: The previous server handled 500 requests per minute. The new one handles twice ------- requests.

choices.B: more many

questions.translationJa: 旧サーバーは1分あたり500件を処理しました。新サーバーはその2倍の件数を処理します。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数requestsの倍率はtwice as manyです。

questions.prompt: Only twelve people attended last year, but eighty have registered this year. We need ------- more chairs.

choices.B: many

questions.translationJa: 昨年の参加者は12人だけでしたが、今年は80人が登録しています。椅子がはるかに多く必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数chairsの大幅な増加はmany moreで示します。

questions.prompt: The new database contains video as well as text. It requires ------- more storage than the old database.

choices.B: very

questions.translationJa: 新しいデータベースは文章に加えて動画も含みます。旧データベースよりはるかに多くの記憶容量が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算storageの大きな差なのでmuch moreです。

questions.prompt: The initial repair estimate was high. After the inspection, the final amount was even -------.

choices.B: highest

questions.translationJa: 当初の修理見積額は高額でした。点検後、最終額はさらに高くなりました。
questions.explanationJa: すでに高い水準をさらに上回るためeven higherが適切です。

questions.prompt: A taxi takes 20 minutes to the venue, while the bus takes 50. The taxi is ------- faster.

choices.B: far

questions.translationJa: タクシーは会場まで20分、バスは50分かかります。タクシーの方がはるかに速いです。
questions.explanationJa: 30分の大差がある文脈ではfar fasterが自然です。

questions.prompt: The loading dock closes at 7:00, not 7:30. The carrier must arrive thirty minutes ------- than planned.

choices.B: very early

questions.translationJa: 搬入口は7時30分ではなく7時に閉まります。運送会社は予定より30分早く到着しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 時間差をthirty minutes earlier thanで示します。

questions.prompt: Printing one booklet in black and white costs two dollars; printing it in color costs six. Color printing is three times ------- expensive as black-and-white printing.

choices.B: more

questions.translationJa: 小冊子1部の白黒印刷は2ドル、カラー印刷は6ドルです。カラー印刷は白黒印刷の3倍高価です。
questions.explanationJa: 正確な倍率はthree times as expensive asで表し、2ドルと6ドルの関係にも合います。

questions.prompt: The team can finish the report at home or commute for two hours. Working at home is much more efficient ------- commuting.

choices.B: than

questions.translationJa: チームは自宅で報告書を仕上げるか、2時間通勤できます。自宅作業の方が通勤よりはるかに効率的です。
questions.explanationJa: 行動句workingとcommutingをthanで比較し、muchが大差を示します。
